column2: I told my wife she was drawing her eyebrows too high. She looked surprised.
Why don't scientists trust atoms? Because they make up everything.
I'm on a seafood diet. I see food and I eat it.
Knock knock. Who's there? Lettuce. Lettuce who? Lettuce in, it's freezing out here.
My wallet is like an onion. Every time I open it, I cry.
I used to be a banker, but then I lost interest.
A horse walks into a bar. The bartender says, hey, why the long face?
I asked the librarian if they had any books on paranoia. She whispered, they're right behind you.
My bed is a magical place where I suddenly remember everything I was supposed to do.
I don't suffer from insanity. I enjoy every minute of it.
Why did the scarecrow win an award? Because he was outstanding in his field.
I told my boss I needed a raise because three companies are after me. He asked which ones. I said the electric company, the gas company, and the water company.
My therapist says I have a preoccupation with vengeance. We'll see about that.
Parallel lines have so much in common. Shame they'll never meet.
I used to play piano by ear, but now I use my hands.
What do you call a fish with no eyes? A fsh.
I'm reading a book about anti-gravity. It's impossible to put down.
The rotation of the earth really makes my day.
I told my computer I needed a break. Now it won't stop sending me KitKat ads.
Why did the bicycle fall over? Because it was two-tired.
My grandma's Wi-Fi password is so long I have to visit her just to get online.
I wanted to lose ten pounds this year. Only thirteen to go.
A man walks into a library and asks for a book on committing the perfect murder. The librarian whispers, try the true crime section.
I asked Siri why I'm still single. She turned on the front camera.
My house was clean last week. Sorry you missed it.
I don't need a parachute to skydive. I need a parachute to skydive twice.
The first rule of Thesaurus Club is you don't talk about, mention, speak of, discuss, or chat about Thesaurus Club.
Why did the math book look so sad? It had too many problems.
I have a joke about construction, but I'm still working on it.
My dog used to chase people on a bicycle. It got so bad I had to take his bike away.
I told the waiter my soup was cold. He said, that's the gazpacho.
What do you call fake spaghetti? An impasta.
I wanted to tell you a joke about an elevator, but it's an uplifting story.
The comedian quit his job at the calendar factory. His days were numbered.
I asked my dad for a joke about paper. It was tearable.
My phone bill is so high it has its own area code.
I'm so good at sleeping I can do it with my eyes closed.
I have a fear of speed bumps, but I'm slowly getting over it.
The graveyard shift is dead quiet. The workers are just dying to leave.
I told my suitcase there would be no vacation this year. Now I'm dealing with emotional baggage.
